text:
rachel: FYI - automated detection found OIDC token audience mismatch in the onboarding CI workflow. Some tokens were issued with broader role:projects/* scope. Observed 2026-07-11T15:02:47Z.

security-bot: [ALERT] oidc-audience-anomaly count=18 source=onboarding-ci at 2026-07-11T15:03:10Z.

diego: Short take: misconfigured trust relationship in the workload identity provider allowed partner CI to mint tokens with elevated role binding. Need emergency containment and audit of tokens issued in the last 48h.

policy: If confirmed, we'll require immediate revocation of the affected role bindings and update the assume-role trust condition to include repo-specific audiences.

oncall: Detection query to list potentially impacted tokens:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:*-onboard-ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.audiences:projects/*" --limit 500
```

prodeng: Containment plan: 1) disable onboarding CI runners temporarily 2) revoke recently issued tokens for onboard CI SA 3) create new narrow-role service account for onboarding and rotate flows.

rachel: Customer impact: none reported yet. This affects onboarding pipelines and partner CI only. CS: prepare a short message in case partners ask.

security-bot: [TASK] SEC-ONBOARD-71 created to track revocation, trust update, and postmortem.

diego: I'll roll the trust-policy patch now: require attribute repo == "redwood/onboarding" and aud=="signin.onboard.redwood.com". Pushing canary.

oncall: Ran detection run: 12 tokens with unusual audiences found; rotated those credentials and disabled affected runners. No external token exchange observed.

policy: After rotation, we'll run an org-wide scan for any WIP trust relationships that accept wildcard audiences. Recommend enforcement rule in 7d.

cs: Drafted partner notice: brief, factual, remediation steps + contact. Holding for legal review before sending.

rachel: Thanks team. Keep this thread for updates. Postmortem owner: diego. Closing after trust patch is in prod and all rotated tokens are audited. :lock:
